title: 2D Particle Physics Simulator
description:
Create a class called `Particle` that simulates a particle moving in 2D space under the influence of gravity and air resistance.

The class should be initialized with:
- x, y: initial position coordinates (in meters)
- vx, vy: initial velocity components (in meters per second)
- mass: particle mass (in kilograms)

The class should provide these methods:
- update(dt): Update the particle's state after a time step dt (in seconds)
- get_position(): Return the current (x, y) position as a tuple
- get_velocity(): Return the current (vx, vy) velocity as a tuple  
- get_kinetic_energy(): Return the current kinetic energy

Physics background:
Particles in motion are affected by multiple forces:
- Gravity pulls objects downward with a constant acceleration (9.8 m/s²)
- Air resistance (drag) opposes motion and is proportional to velocity (use drag coefficient k = 0.1)
- Forces cause acceleration according to Newton's laws
- Energy can be calculated from mass and velocity
- Position and velocity change over time based on these forces

Your simulation should use numerical integration to update the particle state at each time step.
